title: 3 animals that see the world differently
caption:
Three animals whose eyes break the rules.

The owl findings come from Johns Hopkins scans of snowy, barred and great horned owls; 12 of their 14 neck vertebrae have extra room around the main artery.

Sources: Florida Museum of Natural History; Johns Hopkins (Science, 2013); UC Berkeley Understanding Evolution. Footage: great horned owl. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
